title: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Seniors
h1: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Seniors
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for fitness trackers for seniors, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at fitness trackers for seniors using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.blurb: Key specs: Large, readable touchscreen with adjustable text size, Irregular heart rhythm notifications, Body Battery energy tracking.
strengths: Text size adjustment in settings makes notifications and stats easier to read at a glance
Irregular heart rhythm alerts run passively in the background with no extra steps
No subscription fee keeps ongoing cost at zero after purchase
Soft silicone band stays comfortable through all-day wear, including for sensitive skin
limitations: Small physical size means the screen is still modest compared to a full smartwatch
Initial pairing requires a smartphone app, which can be a barrier without help
Fewer big, colorful visual cues than some simpler senior-focused devices
features: Large, readable touchscreen with adjustable text size

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
products.blurb: Key specs: Irregular heart rhythm notifications, Fall-aware activity and stress detection, Simple guided app setup.
strengths: Guided setup walks through pairing step by step with clear prompts
Family members can view shared activity summaries, useful for keeping an eye on a parent from afar
Bright AMOLED display makes step count and heart rate easy to read without reading glasses in most lighting
Automatic exercise recognition means no manual button presses needed to log a walk
limitations: Most detailed heart health trend data sits behind a Fitbit Premium subscription
7-day battery still requires a recurring reminder to charge for those prone to forgetting
Touchscreen and side button combination takes a session or two to learn
features: Large notification text on AMOLED display

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Fit3
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6-inch AMOLED display, 13-day battery life, Sleep and snore tracking.
strengths: 1.6-inch display is the largest and easiest to read of the group at a glance
13-day battery life means infrequent charging reminders
Affordable price makes it easy to replace if lost or damaged
Simple swipe-based navigation once shown once by a family member
limitations: Full functionality requires an Android phone, which rules out iPhone-owning seniors
No irregular heart rhythm notification feature like Fitbit or Garmin
Smaller companion app ecosystem than Fitbit or Garmin for long-term support

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
